He also received nominations in the Hong Kong Film Awards for his score to Chow's 2001 film "Shaolin Soccer", and for the 1995 Tsui Hark film "Love in the Time of Twilight" ( ).

It was the opening film at the 63rd Berlin International Film Festival in February 2013.  The film was selected as part of the 2013 Hong Kong International Film Festival. He began his career as a screenwriter in 1982, then made his directoral debut in 1988.  As of 2015, he has directed 10 feature films.  He has also worked as producer on several films he did not direct.  Wong has also directed short films, commercials, and two music videos.

He has participated in all of Wong Kar Wai's films.
